objective: Establish whether accepted Curunir V6 operates coherently across realistic heterogeneous intelligence missions with genuine human operation, preserved lineage, measurable outputs, and semantic replay.
invariants: One inherited hash-chained mission store remains authoritative; V6.8 creates no parallel provenance system.
All V6.7 marking, identity, signed-action, egress, recovery, replay, resource, and baseline gates remain in force.
Every settled final conclusion has resolvable evidence descent to hash-verified custody; inference and forecast remain typed judgment.
A human-only transition is accepted only when the retained store records a genuine human actor action; fixture or harness actors cannot satisfy human participation.
A failed mission cannot be waived into a pass.

operator_protocol.revision_note: V68_TERMINAL_001 through V68_TERMINAL_003 are retained pre-human roots. Canonical human-pilot root is V68_TERMINAL_004 after closing remaining M3 path and content-binding residuals. Acceptance criteria are unchanged.
operator_protocol.surface: Existing Curunir workbench, CLI, and HTTP API only; no new UI.
participants: one distinct genuine human approver for every mission's four-eyes signed disposition
sequence: inspect mission state and exact evidence
task and receive collection where required
instrumentation: system event sequence before and after
operator_protocol.privacy: Record actor ids and mission actions only. Do not record secrets, bearer tokens, private keys, unrelated browsing, keystrokes, or personal data.

allowed: lawful public live sources already registered in V6
clearly labeled notional fixtures with frozen bytes
forbidden: uncustodied manual paste presented as source evidence
test mocks claimed as production acquisition

measurement_record.threshold_law: No performance threshold is invented. Binary integrity conditions may require exact success; descriptive timing and count measurements are reported without pass thresholds.

evidence_requirements: Every cited id resolves to the intended record and current or explicitly historical version.
Every material claim descends to exact anchors and hash-verified manifestation custody.
Every SUPPORTED sentence is content-bound to the exact statement or asserted value of a cited observational record; citation shape alone is insufficient.
Temporal ordering uses recorded and valid time correctly.
Corrections, retractions, supersession, source dependence, restrictions, and confidence survive into outputs.
Restricted basis cannot appear in a lower-marking derived artifact.
Unsupported settled claims are forbidden; explicitly unresolved statements remain eligible when labeled.
replay_requirements: Replay starts from the exported package in a fresh destination under an enforced denied-network context; the replay path invokes no model provider.
Store chain, payload hashes, signed actions, and access-aware projections verify.
Evidence arrival, state transitions, hypotheses, forecasts, collections, alerts, analyst decisions, and signed disposition reconstruct semantically.
Semantic identity is canonical JSON over the defined audit state; irrelevant wall-clock duration, port, path, and UI rendering are excluded.
mission_success: distinct approver's genuine signature is retained

terminal_verdict.PASS: All V6.8 conditions hold and the full repository has no residual nonpass.
terminal_verdict.PASS_WITH_ACCEPTED_BASELINE_RESIDUALS: All V6.8 conditions hold, no new regression exists, and only the exact accepted V6.7 baseline residual subset remains.
terminal_verdict.NOT_ACHIEVED: Any required mission, human participation, evidence fidelity, signed disposition, replay, coverage, clean reconstruction, or regression gate is absent or failing.

failure_classes.A: V6 correctness or required-capability defect; repair minimally and rerun affected gates.
failure_classes.B: V6.8 fixture, harness, instrumentation, measurement, or verifier defect; repair and rerun affected gates.
failure_classes.C: Usability or UI issue; record unless it makes the mission impossible.
failure_classes.D: V7 Maven-class capability; record in the V7 ledger and do not implement.
failure_classes.E: Environment or external-source failure; retain as failure data and retry only within frozen policy.
failure_classes.F: Accepted baseline residual unrelated to mission validity; retain exact identity and severity.

required_coverage: semantic world state and temporal change
forbidden_shortcuts: trusting packaged status or coverage without live-root re-derivation
terminal_evidence: live-root re-derivation and byte agreement with each canonical package
capability coverage matrix using exact frozen labels
escalation: Stop for the genuine human pilot boundary.
Stop before any change that would weaken a V6.7 invariant.
Defer any missing Maven-class function to V7.
Return NOT_ACHIEVED when required evidence cannot be established.
